use_cases.scenario: Append text to that note.

use_cases.scenario: Find the latest authorized meeting summary.

use_cases.scenario: Create a meeting action item.

use_cases.scenario: Draft a follow-up from this meeting.

use_cases.scenario: Send that follow-up.
use_cases.acceptance: Show exact recipients/content/attachments; require policy-authorized confirmation.

use_cases.scenario: Rename/move a selected file.

use_cases.scenario: Start meeting transcription.

use_cases.scenario: Transcribe French/English code-switching with names and numbers.

use_cases.scenario: Several people overlap or system audio echoes the microphone.

use_cases.scenario: Switch headset, mute, suspend or reconnect.
use_cases.acceptance: Audio clock/channel identity remain consistent; gaps are surfaced.

use_cases.scenario: Ask for a recap during a meeting.
use_cases.acceptance: Derived summary links to available evidence; unresolved/uncertain statements remain qualified.

use_cases.scenario: Correct a recognized amount or negation.
use_cases.acceptance: User correction is distinguished from provider output and propagated safely to derivatives.

use_cases.scenario: End a summary-only meeting.
use_cases.acceptance: Only permitted summaries/actions/metadata persist; raw buffers and disallowed temporary data are cleared.

use_cases.scenario: Open Photo Booth / Camera and take a photo.

use_cases.scenario: Where do we stand on this account?
use_cases.acceptance: Authorized, current evidence with dates; unknowns and stale records clearly indicated.

use_cases.scenario: What changed since my previous review?

use_cases.scenario: Show overdue commitments.
use_cases.acceptance: Use recorded owners/dates; do not invent deadlines from vague language.

use_cases.scenario: Explain why this risk is highlighted.
use_cases.acceptance: Show permitted source references and provenance, not hidden chain-of-thought.

use_cases.scenario: Search across my approved second brain.
use_cases.acceptance: Respect file/access scope and exclude revoked/deleted/confidential records.

use_cases.scenario: Merge duplicate account/person records.
use_cases.acceptance: Preview the merge and retain reversible provenance; no model-only destructive merge.

use_cases.scenario: A sync conflict or permission change occurs.
use_cases.acceptance: Invalidate affected cache/output; show recoverable conflict, not an invented fresh result.

use_cases.scenario: Jev/Laya/Apple inference is unavailable.
use_cases.acceptance: Use only eligible policy-approved alternatives or explicit unavailable mode; no invented scores.

use_cases.scenario: A user signs in on two computers.
use_cases.acceptance: One verified person, two devices, separate sessions and event-time attribution.

use_cases.scenario: An admin checks 24-hour consumption.
use_cases.acceptance: Full authorized interval totals agree with ledger and export; table pagination is independent.

use_cases.scenario: A retry or late client event arrives.
use_cases.acceptance: Deduplicate delivery, preserve authoritative usage; distinct billed attempts remain distinct.

use_cases.scenario: An admin selects Jev or Laya.
use_cases.acceptance: Real backend selection, entitlement and serving version change are tested; no cosmetic dropdown.

use_cases.scenario: PCC is available or its user quota is exhausted.
use_cases.acceptance: Native route reports real availability; portal records known metadata and unavailable quantities honestly.

use_cases.scenario: A support viewer opens a user record.
use_cases.acceptance: Only authorized support metadata is visible; no prompts, tokens/keys or unrelated user data.

use_cases.scenario: An admin revokes a device or lowers a budget.
use_cases.acceptance: New server work/step commits obey the policy; queued work cannot regain old authority.

use_cases.scenario: The accounting pipeline falls behind.
use_cases.acceptance: Surface lag/partial totals and alerts; never paint missing usage as zero spending.

use_cases.scenario: Fresh cloud-first Windows installation.
use_cases.acceptance: Signed core reaches readiness without unwanted local model downloads.

use_cases.scenario: Select an optional offline language/model pack.
use_cases.acceptance: Show bytes and purpose, obey policy/network choice, verify and atomically activate it.

use_cases.scenario: Network drops during component download.
use_cases.acceptance: Resume compatible ranges or restart safely; no corrupt/partial component activates.

use_cases.scenario: A component manifest or asset is tampered with.
use_cases.acceptance: Reject before loading/execution; expose actionable repair with no verification bypass.

use_cases.scenario: Upgrade an existing 1.x installation.
use_cases.acceptance: Settings, identity, notes, permissions and update continuity survive; no profile wipe.

use_cases.scenario: Low disk space or a metered network is detected.
use_cases.acceptance: Show required free space/transfer, permit pause and a lean viable path; no surprise bulk transfer.

use_cases.scenario: Native Mac signing or PCC eligibility is absent.
use_cases.acceptance: QA/public/PCC states stay distinct; Windows qualified release is not blocked by a fabricated Mac asset.

use_cases.scenario: Roll back a failed application/component rollout.
use_cases.acceptance: Restore an allowed compatible version safely; migration and key protections remain valid.

use_cases.scenario: Fresh Windows/native Mac user opens Speech Settings.
use_cases.acceptance: Cloudflare is selected; local speech/LLM packs are not installed or loaded; no request for an account API token.

use_cases.scenario: Say a command while no meeting is active.
use_cases.acceptance: Only the authorized command microphone track goes to cloud speech after wake; no empty system-audio socket.

use_cases.scenario: The user remains silent before wake.
use_cases.acceptance: No ambient audio or idle transcript reaches a cloud endpoint; no billable speech stream is kept open merely for an orb.

use_cases.scenario: Speech route logging/cache configuration drifts.
use_cases.acceptance: Privacy readiness fails; new content sessions are stopped from starting; the operator sees a safe metadata alert.

use_cases.scenario: Cloudflare or its entitlement is unavailable.
use_cases.acceptance: Clear error and typed/manual alternatives; no automatic third-party route, local-model install or deferred audio upload.

use_cases.scenario: User opens Optional local models on a low-memory device.
use_cases.acceptance: Explain measured constraints and compatible choices; do not install a pack on a device-name heuristic alone.

use_cases.scenario: User explicitly installs a recommended offline speech pack.
use_cases.acceptance: Compatible signed pack is downloaded, self-tested and offered for selection; generation/vision packs stay absent.

use_cases.scenario: User selects local-only speech and it fails.
use_cases.acceptance: No microphone audio is sent to Cloudflare without an explicit permitted mode change.

use_cases.scenario: Device memory, thermal or battery conditions change.
use_cases.acceptance: Apply safe resource limits or pause with disclosure; no corrupt stream, crash or covert provider switch.

use_cases.scenario: User disables or removes an optional local model.
use_cases.acceptance: Stop/unload its process safely; uninstall only owned files; do not re-download it at next launch.

use_cases.scenario: Admin reconciles two speech tracks and a reconnect.
use_cases.acceptance: Distinguish meeting duration, track audio sent, provider-processed duration and billed units; duplicates/unknowns remain explicit.

use_cases.scenario: The default speech session ends or is revoked.
use_cases.acceptance: Finalize only when allowed, clear volatile buffers, reject stale events and prove no content in controlled persistent sinks.

use_cases.scenario: An approved meeting summary becomes shared knowledge.
use_cases.acceptance: Canonical source/revision and audience persist; graph/wiki are derived and traceable.

use_cases.scenario: Two summaries disagree about the same amount or deadline.
use_cases.acceptance: Conflict remains visible; no model confidence or last writer automatically establishes truth.

use_cases.scenario: A human pins a consequential field.
use_cases.acceptance: Only the authorized exact field/revision is verified; later generated text cannot overwrite it.

use_cases.scenario: Ask where a briefing claim came from.
use_cases.acceptance: Resolve permitted primary/summary evidence with its date and availability; no circular generated citations.

use_cases.scenario: Search a shared account while the desktop is asleep.
use_cases.acceptance: Qualified server serves authorized stored knowledge; device-only sources explicitly report unavailable.

use_cases.scenario: A source is corrected, deleted or becomes confidential.
use_cases.acceptance: Canonical change and tombstone invalidate wiki/graph/context; stale replicas cannot resurrect it.

use_cases.scenario: A graph path would reveal a restricted account relation.
use_cases.acceptance: No hidden node/edge/count/name reaches the caller or model.

use_cases.scenario: A graph/index rebuild fails halfway.
use_cases.acceptance: Readers see an intact prior revision marked stale or unavailable, never a partially promoted graph.

use_cases.scenario: A Dust user asks about their authorized meeting context.
use_cases.acceptance: Personal OAuth/validated principal selects only permitted records; real source citations resolve.

use_cases.scenario: A Dust tool call invents another email or tenant ID.
use_cases.acceptance: Payload identity cannot widen authenticated scope; no disclosure or write.

use_cases.scenario: Dust creates an allowed action item.
use_cases.acceptance: Canonical idempotent commit survives regenerated wiki pages and is visible in Intelligence.

use_cases.scenario: Dust proposes changing a pinned amount.
use_cases.acceptance: Creates a reviewable proposal; cannot self-approve or silently alter the verified field.

use_cases.scenario: Two agents and a human edit one record concurrently.
use_cases.acceptance: Expected-revision conflict prevents lost edits; canonical readback and projection state are honest.

use_cases.scenario: A Dust connection or knowledge grant is revoked.
use_cases.acceptance: Subsequent tools/cache reads fail closed; any configured replica cleanup is tracked honestly.

use_cases.scenario: Admin publishes a reviewed skill.
use_cases.acceptance: Entitled clients see the new version without reinstall; real server execution is demonstrated.

use_cases.scenario: A skill is updated while a run is active.

use_cases.scenario: A skill uses contextual meeting knowledge.
use_cases.acceptance: Scoped source packet adds relevant evidence; no entire private archive or broader audience exposure.

use_cases.scenario: An uploaded skill requests arbitrary scripts or hidden network access.
use_cases.acceptance: Validation/quarantine blocks execution; existing authority cannot be widened by skill text.

use_cases.scenario: A cached or queued skill has been revoked.
use_cases.acceptance: Trusted runtime denies it; rollback cannot restore revoked privileges.

use_cases.scenario: Admin inspects a skill with retries and mixed providers.
use_cases.acceptance: Run/version/attempt totals reconcile; no private inputs/results appear in operational analytics.

use_cases.scenario: A nontechnical user changes microphone or finds privacy controls.
use_cases.acceptance: Plain-language search/navigation works within the proposed usability budget.

use_cases.scenario: An old advanced setting is migrated.
use_cases.acceptance: Its semantics and explicit user choice survive; protected controls stay protected.

use_cases.scenario: Settings save fails or policy changes remotely.
use_cases.acceptance: UI shows effective value and recoverable failure; no misleading enabled state.

use_cases.scenario: A user pauses automatic attendance for one meeting.
use_cases.acceptance: The occurrence is visibly skipped without disabling unrelated authorized workflows.

use_cases.scenario: Sign in to the Teams personal app.
use_cases.acceptance: Validate Entra identity and correct tenant; downstream Graph scopes remain separate.

use_cases.scenario: An enrolled eligible Teams meeting actually starts.
use_cases.acceptance: Supported event triggers one visible join attempt, not just the scheduled clock.

use_cases.scenario: The organizer leaves the bot in the lobby or denies it.
use_cases.acceptance: No capture starts; truthful waiting/denied state and bounded retry; no admission bypass.

use_cases.scenario: Two enrolled colleagues attend one meeting.
use_cases.acceptance: One authorized capture source and intended assistant scope; no duplicate charges hidden by text dedup.

use_cases.scenario: The meeting is rescheduled, cancelled or recurs.
use_cases.acceptance: Correct occurrence ID and latest eligibility; no phantom join to cancelled/private sessions.

use_cases.scenario: The host removes Métis after it joins.
use_cases.acceptance: Stop processing and suppress automatic reentry; late frames/results cannot revive the session.

use_cases.scenario: A participant says Hey Métis close the organizer laptop app.
use_cases.acceptance: Meeting audio has no desktop execution authority; local command consent is required separately.

use_cases.scenario: The Teams live-media recording/status prerequisite is unavailable.
use_cases.acceptance: Live derived-data persistence stays blocked; alternatives accurately state their limits.

use_cases.scenario: A permitted live meeting produces a summary and skill result.
use_cases.acceptance: Persist only allowed knowledge; sharing respects every source audience; portal retains metadata only.

use_cases.scenario: The desktop goes offline while the bot is active.
use_cases.acceptance: Deployed service continues only within its authority; no second source or secret local fallback.

use_cases.scenario: A Zoom/Meet/other meeting is requested.
use_cases.acceptance: Use only a separately qualified supported API/notice path; no fictitious universal bot support.

use_cases.scenario: A data subject requests correction/deletion or objects to processing.
use_cases.acceptance: Authenticated rights workflow propagates across permitted stores/replicas and exposes unresolved obligations.

experience_requirements.implementation: One calm Today view offers the next eligible meeting, last confirmed discussion, outstanding commitments, key unknowns and source dates. Pre-meeting briefs use only authorized context; private-to-me does not imply shareable-to-the-room. Absent calendar access is a clear manual route, not a blank spinner.
experience_requirements.acceptance: A user finds the relevant last commitment within two deliberate interactions on the defined fixture; wrong-account, guest and expired-source tests deny disclosure.

experience_requirements.title: Human notes remain the user’s work
experience_requirements.implementation: Support lightweight human-authored notes and explicit important-moment markers during a meeting. Keep raw human notes, generated enhancements and accepted corrections as distinct revisions. Enhancements are previewed and can be accepted by block; re-run never overwrites newer edits. A moment marker is not permission to retain an audio clip. Persist permitted human notes only in the chosen knowledge environment, never telemetry.
experience_requirements.acceptance: Typing while a partial transcript arrives, enhancement returns late, storage fails or another editor changes a block does not lose human text. The original and accepted revision remain explainable; unretained source intervals are not fabricated quotations.

experience_requirements.title: Useful, quiet live assistance
experience_requirements.implementation: Provide Catch me up, What should I ask?, Explain this term and commitments-so-far in a small optional in-meeting panel. Tie each answer to current authorized interval/source freshness. A coalesced foreground request outranks background analysis. Do not trigger models on every transcript token; no unsolicited speech, focus grabbing or automatic sending.
experience_requirements.acceptance: After a topic change, obsolete suggestions expire without erasing pinned human notes. Verify source intervals, catch-up coverage, request count, latency and no duplicate audio session under real capture.

experience_requirements.title: Trusted follow-through, not a wall of prose
experience_requirements.implementation: Turn an approved summary into a short review inbox: decision, action, owner, due date, evidence and unresolved fields. Draft follow-ups and CRM updates as separate proposals. Show exact destination/object and field diff before consequential commit; resolve unknown outcomes with readback. Drafting, saving, sharing and sending are distinct permissions.
experience_requirements.acceptance: One supported CRM/task/email route is demonstrated with exact-payload approval, idempotency, stale edit conflict and remote object receipt. No universal connector claims or unauthorized automatic sync.

experience_requirements.title: A powerful notebook with fewer settings
experience_requirements.implementation: Today, meeting workspace, search and review should be reachable without a vendor/model menu. Preserve the four Settings destinations and all old-key dispositions. Show recovery and effective policy in context. Include back-to-back meeting handover, clean empty states, narrow windows, keyboard/screen-reader flow and native conventions.
experience_requirements.acceptance: Run the existing nontechnical task study plus back-to-back and permission-denied cases; measure unassisted success, mistakes and time rather than counting screenshots.

experience_requirements.title: Vocabulary and template quality without false certainty
experience_requirements.implementation: Use reviewed, scoped vocabulary only on a transport that supports it and qualifies for privacy. It biases recognition; it cannot substitute a term against evidence. Keep all nine existing role-specific recaps and support reviewed alternate summaries from the same authorized record without overwriting original or human-accepted content.
experience_requirements.acceptance: Held-out names/amounts/negations include plausible-but-wrong glossary matches. Compare critical errors and corrections by language, not just aggregate WER; explicitly unavailable provider features do not get invented flags.

experience_requirements.title: Capture choices with truthful recovery
experience_requirements.implementation: Qualify live command, desktop meeting, supported bot/media and authorized audio/transcript import independently. Capture is neither covert nor universal. Use one occurrence source lease. Safe imports are format/size/sniff constrained, preserve timezone/speaker uncertainty and never silently upload a user-selected local-only file.
experience_requirements.acceptance: Handover from a failed source is explicit and gap-aware, not a second hidden recorder. Crash/reboot cannot resume an expired recording authority. Imported material cannot arm desktop actions or bypass a selected retention profile.

experience_requirements.title: A real enterprise entitlement and trust plane
experience_requirements.implementation: Resolve the source export’s separate legacy license and Operator capability paths. Document issuance, seat/device ownership, offline lease, authority, expiry, revocation and bootstrap. Shared funding is not shared access. Existing legitimate data access/recovery remains possible under a spending outage.
experience_requirements.acceptance: Wrong tenant, dev trust key, copied lease, concurrency race and revoked seat fail appropriate capability boundaries. No unbounded paid relay or accidental second license authority.

experience_requirements.title: No silent loss or misleading success
experience_requirements.implementation: Every save, command, source handover, skill and external write exposes accepted/attempted/committed/verified/unknown accurately. Use revision-aware writes, safe reconciliation and finite retries. Stored-but-indexing is not failed; queued is not committed; a model response is not an object receipt.
experience_requirements.acceptance: Inject failures between commit, receipt and projection. No duplicate side effects, missing summaries painted complete, false native save, swallowed error or resurrected revoked/deleted record.

experience_requirements.title: Animated identity, bounded cost
experience_requirements.implementation: ARMED is only an animated monochrome solving orb on a transparent host, faithful to Libraries.dev. Caption, bar and voice glow appear only with the appropriate active surface. Local animation never represents network/model activity. Honor reduced motion, explicit pause and resource policies; no desktop-wide invisible input region.
experience_requirements.acceptance: Record time-separated frames plus original algorithm/preset lineage; test phase continuity, hide/show, DPR, focus, draft retention, energy policy and real native hit-testing. Pausing the visual does not silently stop or start microphone capture.

experience_requirements.title: Portability and control over knowledge
experience_requirements.implementation: Provide authenticated exports of permitted approved notes/actions with schema, sources, revisions and ownership. Sharing defaults to explicit principals rather than anyone with a link. Revoke links/read paths promptly. Dust edits canonical objects, not generated markdown. Exports do not quietly add unretained transcripts or excluded voiceprints.
experience_requirements.acceptance: Round-trip permitted exports, valid subset imports, CSV/HTML injection tests, redacted fields, wrong-audience links and rights workflows. Expired/deleted links cannot reveal titles/counts or cached content.

experience_requirements.title: Evidence-based competitive and operational qualification
experience_requirements.implementation: Compare the same consented tasks, languages, hardware/network and privacy scope against legitimate available competitor trials. Score completion, critical factual errors, user editing burden, time-to-useful-result, accessibility, total work/cost and resource footprint. Separate vendor claims, source review, simulated UX and executed product evidence. No official affiliation, infallibility or superiority claim is inferred from feature count.
experience_requirements.acceptance: Pre-register supported slices and report failures/abstentions/uncertainty, no cherry-picked clips or changed denominators. Require final signed Windows and native Mac QA receipts, actual backend and mirror-safe release facts before a public claim.

source_findings.title: Do not mistake a source export for a complete checkout
source_findings.source_observation: The export contains 1,521 FILE sections and package version 1.9.5. Five of the 19 file-backed nodes in the supplied map have no source section: renderer App.tsx, main index.ts, renderer lib/listen.ts, main/transcripts.ts and main/brain/ingest.ts. Imports and tests mention them; that does not recover their contents. The filename suffix is not an established Git commit.
source_findings.required_change: Acquire the authorized real checkout and its commit/dirty state. Compare source hashes before using anchors. Preserve the export as historical evidence; never generate stub replacements or run an incomplete reconstructed app as the baseline.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Exact checkout/branch identity and a missing-versus-present source manifest; baseline checks on the complete tree, with every skipped suite explained.

source_findings.title: Separate entitlement authority from telemetry and legacy licensing
source_findings.source_observation: The map separates a license service but omits the consumer edges. Operator has issued-license/seat records, while the legacy service has a serialized JSON store and a separately configured offline lease key. The legacy module describes compiled-off UI gates; the corresponding current renderer files are absent, so actual gate enablement is not established.
source_findings.required_change: Choose one issuer/entitlement authority for each active distribution profile. Entra authenticates identity; a signed license or lease grants only its exact entitlement; telemetry supplies neither identity proof nor permission. Reconcile legacy and Operator IDs without switching on conflicting gates. Production rejects development trust roots. Preserve recovery/export access when paid inference is unavailable.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Activation, renewal, revoke, expired/clock-skewed lease, duplicated device, reinstall, entitlement loss, two-user isolation and cross-process seat-cap races on the actual chosen store. JSON mutex cannot be represented as a distributed lock.

source_findings.title: Apply the Jev decision instead of discarding it
source_findings.source_observation: maybeDisambiguate awaits a successful result then executes void result. It therefore does not apply that decision to the plan in this function.
source_findings.required_change: Validate the returned choice against the exact submitted candidate set, utterance revision, source generation and policy. Apply it through the same deterministic preview/approval path. Retain a useful no-provider deterministic route.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Actual entitled Jev and independent Laya requests affect eligible action and Intelligence results; stale, incompatible, forged and out-of-candidate responses have no side effects.

source_findings.title: Execution result and exception handling must control completion
source_findings.source_observation: flushPending awaits executeDesktopAction but ignores the returned ok/outcome before mark_committed. A test on unsupported Linux expects a committed action; this proves bookkeeping, not successful desktop control. A rejected execution can also re-enter flushPending from finally while pending remains.
source_findings.required_change: Separate dispatch acceptance, attempted side effect, verified completion and unknown outcome. Consume every result and caught exception. Quarantine an uncertain non-idempotent attempt until reconciliation. Retry only bounded classified safe failures; stop must prevent further dispatch.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Adapters returning failed, unsupported, unknown, cancelled or throwing never produce verified success. A rejected or timed-out write cannot create an unbounded retry loop or duplicate note.

source_findings.title: Exact note, camera and close operations need real adapters
source_findings.source_observation: The six-action catalog does not supply general close-app/tab behavior. Windows create-note only launches Notepad and photo capture only opens Camera. Mac note creation removes quotes/backslashes and interpolates changed text into AppleScript; most adapters return unknown.
source_findings.required_change: Implement graceful scope-aware close, exact parameterized text, object identity and postcondition reads. Separate camera preview from shutter permission and resulting file. Reuse actual installed application capabilities; no arbitrary scripts or silent substitute.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Unicode, quotes, backslashes, newlines, missing app, unsaved work, changed focus, camera-busy and repeated intentional actions produce correct real objects or explicit unsupported/unknown results.

source_findings.title: Text matching is not wake-word capture
source_findings.source_observation: The wake helper tests a regular expression against already recognized text. stripWakeWord returns the normalized, lowercased, punctuation-stripped string; it does not preserve the original payload span.
source_findings.required_change: Qualify a compact acoustic wake detector behind explicit opt-in and the single capture owner. Keep the original command text/spans separate from normalized matching. No ambient cloud transcription to find the wake word and no meeting audio authority.
source_findings.exit_evidence: No pre-wake cloud frames; first words survive; exact accents/names/title punctuation survive matching; media replay, other speakers, quotations and false wakes are tested.

source_findings.title: Speech credentials must move behind the session broker
source_findings.source_observation: The credential resolver requires a Cloudflare token/account on the desktop and the error text instructs users to supply an account API token in Settings; an empty gateway uses default.
source_findings.required_change: Replace the centrally funded path with authenticated session grants and server-held credentials. Keep optional personal-key routes explicitly classified rather than silently using them. Remove obsolete onboarding and error instructions.
source_findings.exit_evidence: A new eligible user completes actual speech without an organizational account credential on the device. Revoked or wrong-scope grants fail before upstream audio.

source_findings.title: Gateway creation cannot certify privacy readiness
source_findings.source_observation: ensureDefaultAiGateway posts only id/name, does not inspect the HTTP result, and ignores exceptions. The separate proxy forwards chat requests and returns no-store, but that response header does not establish disabled upstream payload logging or response caching.
source_findings.required_change: Use a named reviewed sensitive-route configuration and explicit readback before protected traffic. Separate chat-only proxy, Operator funding and real-time speech routes. Never auto-create an unreviewed gateway or infer privacy from a successful vault save.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Failure, existing gateway, unsupported WS controls and drift leave privacy readiness blocked; synthetic sentinels inspect every configured controlled sink while usage metadata still settles.

source_findings.title: Legacy embedded credentials and pilot profiles must not leak into 2.0
source_findings.source_observation: Packaging has opt-in embedded credential resources; documentation permits a direct Cloudflare account-token shape. Cahê has a separate identity and deliberately embedded pilot key. Encryption with shipped decryption material is not secret isolation.
source_findings.required_change: The enterprise 2.0 profile forbids reusable organizational credentials in every artifact. Migrate safely from explicit legacy choices, inventory existing exposure privately and rotate only through authorized operations. Do not merge the isolated pilot identity or feed into standard Métis.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Scan and inspect actual final archives/helpers/build outputs, then test two independently authenticated clients with server-only funding and per-device revocation. No private token appears in evidence.

source_findings.title: Preserve authoritative usage and complete aggregates
source_findings.source_observation: ownedAskUpsertSql overwrites update columns with excluded values for same-device collisions. Dashboard starts from listAsks(2000) and other limited detail lists. Both are concrete source risks; no production undercount was measured here.
source_findings.required_change: Add provenance-aware monotonic/reconcilable usage merges and SQL aggregates independent of detail pagination. Preserve the existing cross-device ownership check. Distinguish logical operations, billable attempts and repeated event deliveries.
source_findings.exit_evidence: 120/30 survives a late null update; cumulative 1/15/30 is 30; 2,001 one-token attempts total 2,001; cross-device collision denied; rows/charts/export and exact windows reconcile.

source_findings.title: Native persistence must not hide loss or retain forbidden transcripts
source_findings.source_observation: SwiftData stores full transcript linesData. Encoding failures become empty Data, decoding failures become [], and try? context.save() is followed by returning a StoredMeeting. The caller cannot infer a durable save from that return.
source_findings.required_change: Use throwing or typed save results, transactional metadata and explicit readback. Preserve existing data through approved migrations and implement summary-only storage on native Mac as well as Electron. Distinguish corrupt data from an empty meeting; offer authorized recovery.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Inject disk-full, permission denial, encode/decode corruption, duplicate ID and save errors. No saved success or data-deleting empty fallback; no new raw transcript blob under summary-only policy.

source_findings.title: Native recording and long-session summaries require actual readiness
source_findings.source_observation: The controller permits nil audio hooks and then sets isRecording=true; the comment calls this a test/prototype seam. It appends meeting lines and summarizes a tail. This does not establish capture readiness or complete long-meeting coverage.
source_findings.required_change: Production injection must require a ready audio owner, explicit permission and a successful start result. Separate test drivers from production entry. Stream bounded evidence/summary state across the whole meeting, not only its last tail.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Missing hook/device/service yields unavailable, not recording. Early and late commitments in a two-hour fixture survive within measured memory limits and without durable raw audio.

source_findings.title: Speaker labels are not biometric identity or action authority
source_findings.source_observation: The source implements session clustering and describes persistent named voiceprints plus a Teams-VTT auto-enrollment path. This is materially different from per-meeting anonymous diarization. The reviewed excerpt does not prove which callsites are enabled in the deployed app.
source_findings.required_change: Keep default attribution session-local and uncertain; use authenticated roster metadata only with qualified mapping. Disable unapproved persistent enrollment/voiceprint retention and audit legacy migration without destructive surprise. No speaker score authenticates desktop commands or employee performance.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Fresh default produces no persistent voiceprint; attribution errors, same names, off switch and data-rights deletion are tested. Authorized identity and local command authority remain separate.

source_findings.title: Use the real solving motion without defeating accessibility
source_findings.source_observation: DESIGN.md specifies the real 64-preset monochrome solving orb, without a label. BrandThinkingOrb deliberately keeps animating despite OS reduced motion, although it handles hidden/offscreen suspension. The previously delivered r6 kit made ARMED static; the owner has now explicitly changed that decision.
source_findings.required_change: ARMED is one animated solving orb only. Qualify the installed library API and preserve its geometry, pixel density and motion, not a rotating PNG or improvised constellation. A shared MotionPolicy honors reduce/pause/energy/hidden states; no per-frame React state or microphone.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Time-separated frames and geometry checks prove the solver moves; reduced motion/offscreen/lock stop clocks; CSS and actual native hit regions stay compact. Test declared 41px host and 64 preset separately from the enlarged lab reference.

source_findings.title: Reconcile onboarding contract and recover the real media lineage
source_findings.source_observation: The export identifies the April-29 hero clip and a scripted Act2 product demo rather than one generic onboarding MP4. Older No Skip and auto-local-download instructions conflict with newer requirements for optional educational motion and cloud-first essentials. A referenced filename is not included media bytes.
source_findings.required_change: Preserve the approved artistic lineage and required consent/identity checks; allow reduced/static educational presentation. Keep script-driven demonstration separate from real setup tests. Find the licensed actual hero/music assets in the real checkout; do not substitute the Jev desktop-control clip.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Next advances the actual visible scene once, first-frame fallback works offline, no orphan media continues after finish, and optional packs/video cannot block an otherwise usable cloud core.

source_findings.title: Profile-aware package gates, OS descriptions and documentation must change together
source_findings.source_observation: Build/prepack paths provision local model/speech resources, package manifests copy them, and permission strings/docs describe on-device processing. Existing duplicate/foreign-runtime exclusions are useful optimizations and must remain.
source_findings.required_change: Implement cloud-first/offline-selected/profile manifests from one capability catalog. Make fetch/build/inventory tests agree; do not remove safety checks to delete weights. Update localized OS permission strings and help/IT documentation to the effective route. Keep portable/no-auto-update and native channels explicit.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Fresh core needs no local weights or full model process; complete binary/temporary-size waterfall and profile-aware integrity checks; old explicit offline choices and notices/licenses survive.

source_findings.title: A development-store seam is not production durability
source_findings.source_observation: The map labels operator/src/store.ts as the Operator store; it contains contracts/test memory behavior while d1.ts supplies SQL implementation. The separate license store documents small-dataset single-process durability.
source_findings.required_change: Draw physical stores separately from interfaces. Production must reject placeholder/memory stores and wrong environment bindings. Choose a concurrency-safe source for entitlements and budgets; avoid accidental dual writes across unrelated authorities.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Actual deployment ID/database/schema identity, restart persistence, concurrent admission and isolated restore. Startup/readiness cannot paint an ephemeral fallback as live.

source_findings.title: Mirror-safe release delivery is a first-class gate
source_findings.source_observation: The checked-in script/docs describe a Forgejo push mirror that removes refs missing on its side, and push both github and origin. The actual current mirror settings and cadence were not verified by this source audit.
source_findings.required_change: Discover actual remote URLs, authority, mirror mode and branch/tag rules before writing. Verify both required refs at the same commit and post-sync durability, handle partial push visibly, and retain protected-tag policy. Never disable rules or force-push because an old document says so.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Exact signed-asset hash, canonical feed, source/release tags, required remotes and post-publication readback agree. Missing mirror access is a scoped release blocker if that mirror is actually authoritative.

source_findings.title: Secret scans must not exclude entire tests and documentation trees
source_findings.source_observation: The allowlist covers whole test-file patterns, scripts/qa and Markdown docs, not just known fixture bytes. This creates a blind area even though the comments describe fake examples. No real leaked token was established by this review.
source_findings.required_change: Replace broad exemptions with reviewed narrow rule/fingerprint/line-scoped synthetic exceptions. Scan documentation, tests, fixtures, generated assets and final artifacts. Prevent scanners from printing secrets in reports.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Plant synthetic canary secrets in each formerly excluded class and prove detection; legitimate exact fixtures remain allowed. Run the actual tools on the current commit/history and inspect final artifacts.

source_findings.title: Failed cloud inventory is not an empty account
source_findings.source_observation: The script catches failure of secret list and continues with an empty string, then may replace METIS_PROXY_KEYS. The code correctly refuses when it sees an existing name, but a failed inventory cannot establish absence.
source_findings.required_change: Any retained provisioner must fail on unavailable inventory and require explicit authority for replacement. Stop using embedded shared credentials for enterprise 2.0; archive/deprecate this path safely instead of re-running it automatically.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Access denied/network error leaves all existing secrets unchanged. No delete-existing-secret workaround or successful empty inventory inference.

source_findings.title: Capture privacy copy must cover screenshots, titles, URLs and helpers too
source_findings.source_observation: The product includes screen/OCR paths and the audit document calls meeting-title-derived file basenames metadata. Such labels can still reveal confidential content; audio-only logging rules are incomplete.
source_findings.required_change: Minimize approved window/region observation, exclude credentials and unrelated apps, classify derived text as content. Replace sensitive title/URL labels in operational logs with opaque IDs and approved categorical fields; avoid raw crash/heap exports.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Synthetic meeting title, OCR phrase, URL token and filename sentinels do not persist in prohibited sinks, while authorized knowledge records and meaningful safe diagnostics remain available.

source_findings.title: Preserve tailored recaps and human edits when moving skills server-side
source_findings.source_observation: The source already defines nine mode-specific recap layouts and locked mode skills. A generic new cloud summary would regress this existing capability.
source_findings.required_change: Migrate mode IDs and versioned templates into the central registry with compatibility. Keep original human notes, accepted corrections and generated alternatives separate. Never overwrite manual edits during enhancement, re-template or retry.
source_findings.exit_evidence: All nine layouts render within the answer scroller; update/revoke/version behavior works without reinstall; human text/corrections remain exact after regeneration.

source_findings.title: Dust connector checklists do not prove canonical read/write
source_findings.source_observation: The source includes an unchecked real-Dust verification checklist for a plaintext wiki. That is neither executed evidence nor a canonical mutation interface; the readable projection has its own access boundary.
source_findings.required_change: Reuse the wiki safely, but make personal/service-scoped Dust tools read and mutate canonical records with revision checks and readback. Protect private sources and output audience before retrieval, regeneration and publication.
source_findings.exit_evidence: Actual two-principal Dust read/write, conflict, regenerate, correction, revoke, deletion and laptop-asleep sequence. No raw parent-folder indexing or edits lost on regeneration.

source_findings.title: Every workspace needs a real test/build/release coverage owner
source_findings.source_observation: Root tests explicitly chain proxy and Operator suites. Native Swift and legacy license-server have their own projects/tests, and the export lacks essential root files. Test counts/names and historical README claims do not establish current executed coverage.
source_findings.required_change: Build a workspace/entrypoint inventory for production, test, migrations and native helpers. Run each applicable suite on the correct runtime/OS; bind tests to actual package profile and post-sign artifact. Include generated bundles and policy/data migrations in impact analysis.
source_findings.exit_evidence: No zero-tests pass, excluded workspace, stale generated bundle, native test seam or unsigned rebuild can satisfy release evidence. Missing source/tool/tenant states are explicit and scoped.

gates.title: Source and adoption integrity
gates.acceptance: Every adoption names actual packaged evidence and its limit; no private service or proprietary media is copied.

gates.title: Authorized full-document context
gates.acceptance: The context broker distinguishes current buffer, saved source, visible screenshot, partial read and verified full coverage.

gates.title: Screen guidance without hidden action
gates.acceptance: Annotations carry fresh target identity and do not execute input or impersonate a permission prompt.

gates.title: Safe verbatim dictation and insertion
gates.acceptance: Verbatim content and an optional rewrite stay distinct; exact focus/field and clipboard ownership are validated.

gates.title: Resumable personalized onboarding
gates.acceptance: Existing Métis desktop scene order and native-model ownership remain; progressive capability coaching, Tony-only welcome or text fallback, consent, no-run agent creation and replay are verified in the real product. No replacement wizard.

gates.title: Stable named-agent definitions
gates.acceptance: Agent identity is separate from models/skills/runs and changing its appearance cannot broaden authority.

gates.title: Correct routing and pinned providers
gates.acceptance: Explicit names, focus and turn context resolve to the correct authorized agent; provider pins never silently change.

gates.title: Isolated memory, drafts and source authority
gates.acceptance: Agent memory, draft and source scope are isolated by principal and stable namespace; shared knowledge remains canonical.

gates.title: Bounded concurrent runs and input leases
gates.acceptance: Only one current run can own desktop input per device; cancellation/generation and independent verification gate every effect.

gates.title: Explicit routines and calm suggestions
gates.acceptance: Recurring work has explicit scope, location, timezone and budget; attention respects meeting/privacy state.

gates.title: Probed connectors and typed schemas
gates.acceptance: Ready reflects a real scoped authenticated probe; typed write schemas and readback are required.

gates.title: Central skills and truthful capabilities
gates.acceptance: Published allowed skills determine capabilities; arbitrary local scripts and non-shipped tools do not become enabled by a label.

gates.title: Scoped artifacts and safe previews
gates.acceptance: Outputs exist and verify before presentation; preview, open, export, overwrite and share are separate authority decisions.

gates.title: Per-agent operational truth
gates.acceptance: Operator reconciles real operation, agent, skill, provider and billing identities without content logging.

gates.title: Minimal animated identity and fast Home
gates.acceptance: Orb-only ARMED remains; expanded names are clear, visible animations bounded, history paged and accessibility preserved.

gates.title: Real cross-platform end-to-end qualification
gates.acceptance: A native signed Windows/live-service journey and independent native Mac journey prove actual capabilities and remaining holds.

cases.scenario: A reference contains an old unused skill picker.
cases.expected: Classify the old note separately from live runtime proof; leave actual activation unverified.

cases.scenario: A source contains an account token or a private endpoint.
cases.expected: Do not call it or copy it into Métis; sanitize provenance and use Métis-owned authentication.

cases.scenario: Ask about an off-screen clause in a selected document.
cases.expected: Read the verified full revision through the permitted source or disclose visible-only coverage; cite the exact clause.

cases.scenario: Source permission is removed while extraction runs.
cases.expected: Invalidate the pending generation, do not attach late content and do not satisfy a pending approval with old context.

cases.scenario: Ask Métis to show which button changes export format.
cases.expected: Display a scoped fresh highlight with an explanation; no click or setting change.

cases.scenario: The target moves, scrolls or changes displays.
cases.expected: Invalidate the old highlight and reobserve; never point at the stale coordinate.

cases.scenario: Dictate Québec / R&D, do not send.
cases.expected: Preserve accents and negation; insert only into the approved field without pressing Send.

cases.scenario: Switch to a terminal or another app before insertion.
cases.expected: Block insertion; preserve the draft and offer explicit destination/copy choice.

cases.scenario: Create the recommended starter team then replay setup.
cases.expected: Retain the same IDs and existing work; do not create duplicates or launch tasks.

cases.scenario: Video, speech or an optional connector is unavailable.
cases.expected: Show truthful per-capability readiness, typed/static alternatives and working retry/exit paths.

cases.scenario: Rename Research Scout and change its orb.
cases.expected: Preserve ID, provider pin, memory, jobs and permissions; no duplicate agent.

cases.scenario: Ask to create three agents and then cancel before confirmation.
cases.expected: No task or routine starts; no unconfirmed definitions become active.

cases.scenario: Send a follow-up to a busy named Dust agent.
cases.expected: Queue under its real remote identity and thread; no generic model impersonation.

cases.scenario: Say do it after switching to a different agent or suggestion.
cases.expected: Require an exact pending target; never transfer the previous approval.

cases.scenario: Switch agents with unsent text and attachments.
cases.expected: Restore each exact draft/attachment/scroll state without leaking it into another request.

cases.scenario: Delete or correct an agent fact and regenerate knowledge.
cases.expected: Corrections propagate; deleted/revoked material cannot return from cached agent memory or old backup.

cases.scenario: Two agents request keyboard or pointer control simultaneously.
cases.expected: One lease owner acts, the other waits; no mixed typing or cursor race.

cases.scenario: Cancel a run as its provider result arrives.
cases.expected: Reject late dispatch, release authority, and reconcile any already attempted effect truthfully.

cases.scenario: A device-bound routine misses several runs while locked.
cases.expected: Skip/coalesce per explicit policy and require that device to be eligible; no storm or device substitution.

cases.scenario: A suggestion finishes during a meeting or screen share.
cases.expected: Keep it discoverable without unrequested speech, sound or sensitive floating text.

cases.scenario: Save a syntactically valid but rejected connector token.
cases.expected: Show checking then rejected; never report Connected merely because it was saved.

cases.scenario: An API result is large or paginated.
cases.expected: Use scoped pagination/fields; do not escape to broader GUI control as an automatic fallback.

cases.scenario: Publish a skill update while an agent is running.
cases.expected: Current run stays pinned, later runs use the qualified revision, revoked versions cannot execute.

cases.scenario: A role requests a capability whose provider is not present.
cases.expected: Report unsupported/unavailable accurately; do not loop on Retry or invent output.

cases.scenario: An agent generates a report and the user returns tomorrow.
cases.expected: Find the exact durable result from its manifest without regenerating or changing ownership.

cases.scenario: A preview contains scripts, remote images or a traversal filename.
cases.expected: Sandbox/reject unsafe content and paths; do not execute or exfiltrate.

cases.scenario: Two agents use the same server-held Jev key.

gates.title: Embedded product, lean clients
gates.acceptance: Hindsight is used through Métis identity and surfaces. No new end-user service login, iframe admin console, desktop PostgreSQL or model weights.

gates.title: Approved inputs and canonical authority
gates.acceptance: Only eligible approved summaries/preferences/verified outcomes enter memory. Canonical records remain authoritative and model-generated observations remain labelled.

gates.title: Pre-retrieval authorization and audience
gates.acceptance: A verified principal cannot retrieve another personal/team bank, including through reflect, entities, history, listings, exports or derived pages. Mixed ACL input never reaches a model.

gates.title: No unintended retained content
gates.acceptance: Source-text and LLM traces off; external spans/queues/exports audited. Derived storage explicitly approved. No raw audio/transcript or private content in Cloudflare persistence.

gates.title: Revision-safe retain and durable projection
gates.acceptance: Stable document identity, canonical event time, CAS/fencing and metadata-only outbox survive reordered writes, restarts and ambiguous upstream acknowledgments.

gates.title: Source-linked bounded recall
gates.acceptance: Results are bounded, preserve meaning, resolve to current authorized canonical records and honor required time intervals. Unavailable is not empty.

gates.title: Grounded reflection without false authority
gates.acceptance: Syntheses name permitted sources, uncertainty and freshness; unknown lineage withholds the result. No reflection grants an action or verifies itself.

gates.title: Deletion, correction and no resurrection
gates.acceptance: Revocation blocks reads immediately; dependent observations/models/pages invalidate explicitly; pending work and restored backups cannot resurrect deleted evidence.

gates.title: Named-agent memory isolation
gates.acceptance: Personal preferences, shared team facts and agent-private experience remain distinct. Renames do not change scope, export permissions or identity.

gates.title: Actual Dust and skill interoperability
gates.acceptance: A real Dust agent and published skill retrieve/update authorized canonical records and see refreshed memory without bypassing governance.

gates.title: One accurate operational ledger
gates.acceptance: Ingestion, recall, rerank, reflection and maintenance attempts reconcile with real units and unknowns, not duplicate nested totals or content logs.

gates.title: Fast critical path and useful quality
gates.acceptance: No compulsory memory round trip for an exact open/close command. Paired multilingual evaluation measures quality and total latency/cost against existing retrieval.

gates.title: Simple, controllable UX
gates.acceptance: Memory stays inside Knowledge & skills and Intelligence. User can inspect/correct/forget, use ephemeral interaction and distinguish policy-locked controls.

gates.title: Server deployment and resilient operations
gates.acceptance: Authenticated private API and PostgreSQL, scoped secrets, version/health checks, backups, restore, workload limits and vendor failover policy are exercised.

gates.title: Incremental migration and reversible rollout
gates.acceptance: No automatic historical transcript backfill. Approved projection generations can be rebuilt/rolled back without rolling back canonical edits or revocations.

gates.title: Real cross-platform integrated proof
gates.acceptance: Windows/native Mac, deployed memory, portal, Dust and skills have explicit real proof at the claimed level. No disabled capability or fixture closes the advertised memory promise.

steps.title: Deploy the private service and database

steps.title: Bind real identity and bank generation
steps.implementation: Implement Entra/authorized service principal binding and server-owned bank registry. Partition by tenant, effective security domain and ACL epoch, not guessed email or model tags. Add cross-replica fences and read-lease revocation. Inventory every upstream read/admin endpoint.
steps.acceptance: Two users/two teams/agent cases demonstrate pre-model exclusion and immediate epoch invalidation.

steps.title: Implement canonical-to-memory projection
steps.implementation: Wire the supplied transport into the real canonical service. Use metadata-only outbox references, read approved source at execution, carry event time and revision, stable document IDs, replace only, and bounded batches. Record accepted versus searchable state separately.
steps.acceptance: Concurrent updates, duplicate delivery, negative acknowledgement, crash-after-write, and read-your-write tests on the actual DB/service.

steps.title: Implement bounded recall with lineage
steps.implementation: Resolve nonempty trusted scope before recall; use strict tags and facts-only profile first. Resolve memory IDs to canonical sources with current revisions/ACLs before returning context. Preserve human names/negation and enforce hard date filters outside ranking hints.
steps.acceptance: Authorized source packets, revoked/untagged/fuzzy-scope rejection and measured low-budget queries.

steps.title: Implement correction, tombstone and purge fences
steps.implementation: Persist canonical tombstones before waiting on any in-flight writer. Revoke read leases, implement exact-document cleanup, durable reconciliation and safe generation quarantine. Build dependency tracking for future observations/models; do not wait for richer synthesis to block raw fact reads.
steps.acceptance: Real source deletion during retain/recall, duplicate/out-of-order writes, purge timeout and restored-backup tests. Rich derived-model cleanup is additionally proven in HMSTEP-10.

steps.title: Wire the memory UX into Métis
steps.implementation: Implement the provided memory review/coverage design inside existing Intelligence and Knowledge & skills. Agent threads share authorized context, not private hidden state. Include disabled, syncing, unavailable, partial, revoked and purge-pending labels. Preserve orb-only ARMED and Tony onboarding.
steps.acceptance: Actual Windows/native Mac keyboard/accessibility flows and cross-session authorized recall; no vendor dashboard or second microphone.

steps.title: Connect Dust and server skills
steps.implementation: Use the existing governed MCP/service interface rather than raw Hindsight endpoints. Dust writes through canonical mutation/proposals; skill/agent versions bind source scopes. Propagate corrected records back to memory and all readers.
steps.acceptance: Real Dust read→authorized canonical update→Métis readback→skill reuse, plus revoked audience/agent-switch tests.

steps.title: Qualify observations, mental models and derivative cleanup
steps.implementation: Add complete lineage and scoped refresh for derived observations and reviewed mental models inside homogeneous ACL banks. Wire actual create/refresh/version/failure controls through restricted service administration. Apply existing tombstone/generation fences to all derived models/pages/history and block global-sensitive directives.
steps.acceptance: Real derived answer, human correction, deletion with upstream is_stale unchanged, stale async completion and incomplete lineage all behave correctly. Only then enable the richer profile.

steps.title: Account for every memory workload
steps.implementation: Integrate each actual provider attempt and background task into the existing ledger, including embedding/reranking and optional TypeSafe/Jev reranking. Do not infer Laya compatibility. Show infrastructure allocation separately and suppress payloads/high-cardinality metrics.

Measure citations, temporal errors, contradictions, coverage, abstention and total cost/latency. Include Québec French, English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese; no production-recording retention for benchmarks.

steps.title: Exercise failure and security boundaries
steps.implementation: Test injected memory instructions, poisoned names, global directives, missing auth, key rotation, budget exhaustion, stalled workers, lost network, replica races and provider-retention drift. Local stop and deterministic actions remain independent.
steps.acceptance: Negative test receipts, redacted diagnostics, incident and safe-rebuild runbook, zero unauthorized source disclosure in tested cases.

steps.title: Prove the complete product journeys
